ev.q: Samples obtained immediately after disinfection grew no organisms.
Results from this trial revealed no growth during the 4 days after disinfection.
Clinicians are encouraged to report findings of Ralstonia spp. in patients

methods_quotes.q: a test developed by CDC and performed by The Children's Hospital of Philadelphia
laboratory-generated biofilm (consisting of a mix of organisms) was grown in a Vapotherm device and cartridge for 3 weeks.
samples from both the vapor condensate and the filter cartridge grew Ralstonia spp. in culture at CDC.
